svg.aria-label: C4 Bold Minimal character style sheet
svg.title: C4 Bold Minimal character style sheet
svg.desc: Style sheet for LangQuest character style exploration C4 (bold minimal): construction, line weights, shading rule, palette, expression vocabulary, scale and grayscale checks, do and don't examples.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: C4 · Bold Minimal — character style sheet

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Poster cut-outs: large simplified shapes · two-tone faces · one accent gradient per character (the backing disc) · no outlines · ink features only.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Spec sheet, not production art; labels use system fonts and are not part of the artwork.

svg.text: Shape meets shape. Edges are carried by value contrast, never by a stroke.

svg.text: Two tones per face, one plane.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and under the chin: light comes from the upper-left at about 35°.

svg.text: No nose outline. One small wedge in the shade tone, inside the light plane.

svg.text: Open eyes are 4.8 × 5.8 ellipses. Nothing thinner than 3 px.

svg.text: Rule: five distinct grayscale values per avatar:

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: ink < hair < skin shade < skin light < paper. The disc sits between

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: hair and skin-light in value, so the head always separates from

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: its backing. Hue carries identity; value carries legibility.

svg.text: Always: contemporary everyday clothing for people; no flags, national or religious costume, no ethnic caricature, no real-person likeness; no text, numerals or logos in artwork.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Always: every expression differs by pose or shape, never by colour alone; every avatar keeps ≥ 5 grayscale values; nothing thinner than 3 px on 256 (≈ 0.3 px at 24 px).

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Avatar crop: full 256 circle, head centre at (128, 116), head height 0.47 of the disc; shoulders exit the crop so the figure feels larger than the disc.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Provenance: original work drawn in code (generator.js). No traced, stock, CC0 or AI-generated sources. No fonts embedded.
